name: _template
label: One line: medium + mood (e.g. 'Risograph print collage, warm and loud')

motion.headline: word
rules: Describe how things enter, hold and leave in the reference, in plain sentences.
avoid: list motion the reference never uses

imagePrompt: MEDIUM (e.g. flat vector, gouache, engraving, 3D clay), TEXTURE, RECURRING SHAPES, PALETTE in words and hex, COMPOSITION (subject centered, empty space top and bottom), WHAT IS ABSENT, no text, no watermark
elementPrompt: single isolated {subject} in MEDIUM style, centered, plain pure white background, no shadow, no text
negative: text, letters, logo, watermark, plus anything off-style
